sections.heading: Reuse the groundwork. Focus on the change.
sections.body:
Delivery accelerators are reusable packs and playbooks for more consistent delivery checks and evidence. Select the relevant IP, tailor it to the systems and change in scope, and make readiness review part of the delivery plan.

The portfolio groups below cover modernisation and integration, migration and regression, automated testing and release assurance, Cyber-Safe Delivery, and regulatory and compliance readiness. [Assess your delivery risks](#get-in-touch): share the change type, platforms, assurance risks and release constraints.

sections.heading: Delivery IP across five portfolios
sections.description: The deck’s reusable IP set and Talent/GCC scale contexts. Select applicable assets at assessment; tailor scope and evidence gates to your programme.

products.name: Reusable IP
products.description: Tailor architecture, interfaces, workflow rules and test coverage. Review integration checks, workflow exceptions, release results and security remediation at agreed gates. Digital Transformation owns engineering change; Cyber Security contributes validation.
products.tags: Modernisation & Integration Toolkit|Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework|Automated Testing & Release Assurance Packs|Cyber-Safe Delivery

products.name: Reusable IP
products.description: Tailor platforms, data mappings, business journeys and operating responsibilities. Migration and regression packs separate data reconciliation from behaviour checks and release gates. Review readiness findings, reconciliation results, regression evidence and operating handover.
products.tags: Migration & Readiness|Regression & Release Assurance|Data Migration & Reconciliation|Intelligent Platform Operations

products.name: Reusable IP
products.description: Tailor use cases, data, calibration and model boundaries. Review readiness findings, model results and limitations, or calibrated scenarios. Applicability to each data platform is assessed, not assumed.
products.tags: Data & AI Readiness|Predictive Analytics Suite|Digital Twin & Simulation Suite

products.name: Reusable IP
products.description: Tailor obligations, control scope and security boundaries. Review control maps, audit evidence and baseline findings: security validation identifies exposure; Regulatory & Compliance Readiness maps evidence to obligations. Readiness support does not confer regulatory approval.
products.tags: Regulatory Readiness & Control Mapping|Continuous Compliance & Audit Evidence|Cloud, AI & Identity Security Baselines

products.name: Scale context
products.description: These scale themes are not a separate GCC pack; staff augmentation, managed teams and build-operate-transfer provide the engagement contexts. Agree skills, embedded IP and transfer responsibilities. Review capacity, operating model, delivery gates and capability handover.
products.tags: Scalable Talent & Delivery|Accelerated GCC Setup|Governed Delivery & Embedded IP|Sustainable Capability Transfer

sections.heading: Fit the packs to your delivery plan
sections.description: Select relevant assessment patterns and pack checks; tailor acceptance gates to the programme. Reuse does not make every pack applicable to every technology.

items.title: Risk and readiness map
items.description: Review change, dependencies and assurance obligations.
items.bullets:
Reuse – relevant assessment patterns
Accept – scope, risks and required gates

items.title: Selected IP set
items.description: Select applicable packs and adapt checks to the technology and requirements.
items.bullets:
Reuse – relevant pack set
Accept – tailored checks and responsibilities

items.title: Evidence at defined gates
items.description: Run the automated and manual checks agreed for each stage.
items.bullets:
Reuse – selected checks and evidence structure
Accept – results, gaps and remediation

items.title: Release evidence
items.description: Review findings with accountable owners and retain the decision evidence.
items.bullets:
Tailor – release decision and handover
Accept – release gate and evidence record

sections.note: Source/target scope → reconciliation and regression checks → results and exceptions → an accountable release decision with retained evidence. This shows the review structure, not an actual IP screenshot or measured client delivery result.

sections.heading: Which packs fit your programme?
sections.description: First value is an accepted readiness map and selected pack set. Timing depends on access, scope, evidence quality and remediation; any acceleration is measured against an agreed like-for-like baseline.

items.title: Change and applicable IP
items.description: Choose the pack set from the actual programme scope, not from a generic platform promise.
items.bullets:
Modernisation – architecture and interface scope
Migration – data mappings and reconciliation rules
Release – changed journeys and gate criteria

items.title: Access and evidence
items.description: Readiness depends on accessible systems and accountable review.
items.bullets:
Provide – approved system access and evidence
Name – delivery, security and control owners
Agree – acceptance gates and release constraints

items.title: Adoption and ownership
items.description: Separate reusable delivery IP from proprietary product licences.
items.bullets:
Confirm – pack applicability and reuse rights
Agree – engagement and handover scope
Name – maintenance and support owners

sections.note: Choose an engagement model to fit scope and accountability: fixed price for defined gates, time & materials for evolving discovery, or an agreed team or managed delivery model. Reuse rights, product licence dependencies, handover and maintenance are agreed separately.

sections.heading: Delivery IP across your programme
sections.description: Connect Linkworks, testoriumz and release packs through Modernisation & Programme Assurance; scope VectorX separately for repo-to-release analysis. Potential contexts include BFSI control evidence, Public Sector approvals and Manufacturing migration. Licences are not automatically bundled.

items.title: Intelligent Workflow Automation
items.description: Use reusable workflow patterns alongside quality, release and security checks.

items.title: Capability Centres with Embedded IP
